Product Distribution through Convenience Stores 
In 2025, the Company launched new products in 7 -Eleven including Milk Bun, 
Chocolate Bun, Chocolate Mud Cake, and Banana Caramel Cake the Company 
also collaborated with various brands to develop new items such as Double 
Choco Pan, Shio Pan and Tirol Chocolate. 
2Launch of “After You Tea ” to Expand into 
Ready -to-Drink (RTD) Market
The Company launched After You Tea, a new Ready -to-Drink beverage line, to 
expand its product portfolio and reach a broader consumer base, with 
nationwide distribution through After You dessert cafés and 7-Eleven stores.
New Product Lines and Collaboration Campaigns  
In 2025, the Company expanded its product portfolio through continuous new 
and seasonal launches across Dessert Café and Drinks, while also extending 
into Non -Café products to broaden consumption occasions beyond the café 
setting. In parallel, the Company pursued strategic collaborations with selected 
partners to introduce co -created menus, enhancing product variety.

The changes  were as follows :
•Cash and Cash Equivalent : increased  by THB 145 million  mainly  
due to cash inflows  from operating  activities .
•Other  Current  Assets : decreased  by THB 231 million  mainly  due to 
the sale of matured  investments .
•Other  Non-current  Assets : increased  by THB 40 million  mainly  due 
to the increase  in right-of-use assets .As of 31 December  2025, the total liabilities  of the Company  was THB 
491 million,  increased  by THB 26 million  or 5.6% from 31 December  
2024. The increase  was due to the following : 
•Current  Liabilities : decreased  by THB 14 million  due to the payment  
of income  tax payable .
•Non-current  liabilities : increased  by THB 40 million  mainly  due to 
the increase  in lease liabilities  and provision  for employee  benefits .As of 31 December  2025, the total equity  of the Company  was THB 1,034
